title: Upload a document to the patient
summary: Clinical → Documents: upload PDFs or images (consents, studies, X-rays).

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Patient documents
steps.details: Uploaded ones and session attachments. Tap one to view it.

steps.title: Choose the file
steps.details: Tap or drag the file: PDF, image or Word, up to 10 MB.

steps.title: Upload
steps.details: Enabled once you've chosen the file.
